title: Organization
description: The organisation's own settings: its display name, its company email domains and whether Drift protection is on. One per tenant, named default. A field left out is left as it is. Applying needs an owner or admin. Deleting the document only stops managing these settings: the organisation itself is never deleted, and the settings keep their values.

displayName.description: The organisation's name as people see it, such as Acme Corporation. It is kept on the organisation's identity group, where it was set from the company name, or the email domain, when the organisation was created.

companyEmailDomains.description: The organisation's own email domains, such as acme.com. The Contributors page classes a contributor whose commit email is at one of these domains as internal, and everyone else as external. An empty list clears them, which means not configured: no contributor is classed either way.

items.description: A domain name in lower case, without a leading @.

driftProtection.description: Whether the console and the legacy APIs refuse changes to settings that are managed by Platform IaC. false is advisory only: the console shows which settings are managed as code and still lets an owner or admin change them. true enforces it: a write from the console, an ApiKey or a legacy endpoint to a kind that has an object managed by Terraform or GitOps is refused with HTTP 409 managed_by_platform_iac. Writes from Platform IaC (the config API with a management token) are never refused, and neither is this setting, so an owner or admin can always turn it off.
